demandOutlook.title: Demand outlook
demandOutlook.description: Orders due through {{cutoff}}. Expected weight helps plan the shift; only physical bag intake admits floor work.
demandOutlook.forecastUnavailable: Unavailable while inputs or live production are unresolved
demandOutlook.missingEstimate_one: {{count}} order is visible but excluded from weight totals because its legacy estimate is unavailable.
demandOutlook.missingEstimate_other: {{count}} orders are visible but excluded from weight totals because their legacy estimates are unavailable.
demandOutlook.reconciliationDescription_one: {{count}} order is at a different lifecycle point in Cents and LPMS. Confirm physical truth before changing its LPMS batch.
demandOutlook.reconciliationDescription_other: {{count}} orders are at different lifecycle points in Cents and LPMS. Confirm physical truth before changing their LPMS batches.
demandOutlook.compactGuidance: Expected demand stays outside executable production until bag intake is recorded. Open Schedule for the advisory batches and order-level comparison.
demandOutlook.noForecastDescription: The current shift needs a published configuration, or production is already active. Current demand remains visible in Orders.
demandOutlook.noBatchesDescription: No known demand can be placed with the current hard capacity.
demandOutlook.unplacedDescription_one: {{count}} whole order cannot fit in a forecast batch. Review its estimate or capacity before planning.
demandOutlook.unplacedDescription_other: {{count}} whole orders cannot fit in forecast batches. Review their estimates or capacity before planning.
demandOutlook.noDemand: No demand is due in this service day
demandOutlook.noDemandDescription: New or overdue orders due before {{cutoff}} will appear here.

reconciliation.source_ahead: Cents is further ahead than LPMS. Confirm the order's physical state, then reconcile its LPMS batch instead of finishing the order automatically.
reconciliation.source_withdrawn: Cents canceled this order after LPMS recorded physical intake. Keep floor work unchanged until a manager confirms the correct batch action.
reconciliation.source_behind: LPMS finished this order, but Cents still shows an earlier status. Confirm both systems before closing the mismatch.
